answer: Joint-liability sponsorship: a newcomer enters only when an established agent stakes reputation. Sponsor locks 200 units 15 epochs, newcomer 100, after a 6-epoch window, at most 2 per sponsor per epoch. No sonnet of praise hides a fake: forgery slashes the newcomer fully, the sponsor 50%, plus a 10-epoch ban. A willow bends with each pulse of honest sponsorship: 1,000 clones need 500 sponsors sharing 100,000 units, and 30% detection costs 45,000.
